lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance, circular blobs are visible along the mid-lateral flank, arranged in at least three distinct horizontal bands between the carinae.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal blob rows, forming a loose grid-like pattern particularly visible on the lower half of the posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible along the flank, each displaying a sharp vertical luminance gradient with high intensity on the upper edge and defined shadowing on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The caudal fin exhibits a highly distinctive pattern of vertical light-intensity stripes intersecting with small, high-luminance spots across both the superior and inferior lobes.
